what: Regional connectivity disruptions during national elections.
cause: Deliberate damage to backbone fiber.

what: Widespread service disruption.
cause: Requests stalled waiting on an internal login service, exhausting server resources; a legacy login server was involved.

what: Network outage on AS3243.
cause: Reported cyberattack.

what: Gemini 3.1 Pro errors for 7h22m.
cause: 'Triggered by a recent rollout.'

what: National internet disruption of about 3 hours; HTTP traffic fell 63%.
cause: Power failure at an interconnection facility.

what: NAS flight data system failed; about 2,000 UK flights cancelled.
cause: Latent software defect with a ~1 ms exposure window. Not cyber.

what: All three providers had outages that began within 77 minutes of each other.
cause: OpenAI: its routing system misread a configuration update. Anthropic: cause not named. xAI: Memphis compute outage (per eWeek).

what: Compute network isolation for 4h11m.
cause: Fiber unplugged during a routine router capacity upgrade; procedural error.

what: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Graph, Defender and Copilot degraded for 66h52m; about 5% of Exchange affected.
cause: PIR: a code update to the certificate management system stopped distributing certificates; the problem stayed latent until existing certificates expired.

what: App and online banking outage; the second in a fortnight.
cause: None given.

what: About 27 services degraded for 2h22m.
cause: Scheduled fiber maintenance reduced network capacity and automated rerouting failed.

what: ChatGPT sign-ins and sign-ups failed for about 30 minutes.
cause: A deployment applied two incompatible configurations.

what: From 3:13 to 10:19 am, call takers could not hear 911 callers; 319 callers affected, 113 never got through.
cause: Motorola's overnight firewall firmware update, rated 'low risk'.

what: About 20% error rates on web and API for 7h35m.
cause: A traffic peak pushed load balancers past their limits and a sidecar did not scale; a latent client retry bug amplified traffic.

what: Mastercard, Apple Pay and ATM transactions declined across Australia; CommBank called it a global Mastercard issue.
cause: Mastercard: 'A scheduled system update caused Mastercard transactions to be declined.'

what: Near-total traffic drop from AS22612.
cause: Cooling failure at a Phoenix data center.

what: 13 status incidents in 8 days across R2, Durable Objects, KV, Workers AI and email; a major email delivery disruption on Aug 12.
cause: Aug 12 incident tied to a Spamhaus listing. Single source.

what: Actions runs failing for 10h42m; Pages and webhooks degraded.
cause: A routine deployment to an internal Actions service reduced capacity; a latent bug in job assignment slowed recovery.

what: Exchange open delayed and trading halted for more than 3 hours.
cause: Glitches in the trade processing system.

what: FAA nationwide ground stop for American from about 6:30 to 7:18 p.m. ET.
cause: 'A technology issue briefly impacted connectivity for some of our systems.'

org: Lloyds Banking Group / UK Faster Payments
what: Failed transfers and frozen app functions at Lloyds, Halifax, Barclays, HSBC and Monzo. Single source.

what: us-west-2 lost connectivity to the Seattle metro. Apple Pay, Reddit, DoorDash, Hulu, Snapchat, Fortnite and PSN were disrupted for about 80 minutes.

what: Online banking suspended for about 14,000 charity customers for more than a week.
cause: Suspected cyber fraud.

what: Connectivity failures in West US, 14:44 to 19:41 UTC. Windows Update, Microsoft Store and WSUS were affected.
cause: PIR ZJV6-SGG: an over-scoped break-fix repair on an optical device; rolling back the maintenance change restored service.

what: Status incidents: Jul 21, critical errors on several models (2h43m); Jul 29, errors across all models; Jul 30, errors across many models (4h51m).
cause: None posted.

what: Global 5xx/504 errors for CloudFront VPC Origins customers for about 3.5 hours, 07:45 to about 11:18 UTC.

what: Nationwide mobile outage from about 2:50 am. Hundreds of Triple Zero calls failed; trains, traffic lights and Eftpos were also disrupted.
cause: Incorrect date information spread after planned maintenance on the network timing system. A GPS card reset to 2006 because it lacked a firmware update; a 2020 configuration change contributed.

what: GSM-R railway radio failed late Jun 23; all trains nationwide stopped for about 2 to 2.5 hours.
cause: DB: scheduled replacement of a technical component / a technical update. Nothing pointed to sabotage.

what: Global outage from shortly before 10:00 ET to 4:22 p.m. ET. Smaller same-morning Downdetector spikes for Cloudflare, Zscaler and AWS (AWS said no disruption).
cause: No cause published by Meta.

what: Global outage: elevated errors across claude.ai, API/console and Claude Code; users reported fast quota depletion.
